Privacy Policy

Last updated: 6 September 2026

InternHub ("we", "us") is a free platform that helps students in Cameroon discover verified internships. This policy explains what we collect, why, and the choices you have. It is written to be read, not skimmed.

What we collect

  • Account details you give us: name, email, and the profile fields you choose to add (phone, institution, field of study, course, academic level).
  • Preferences you set: the fields, locations and work modes you want matched to you.
  • Your activity on InternHub: internships you save, and the alerts we store on your account.
  • Suggestions you submit, including the role details and the contact email you provide so we can follow up.
  • Sign-in credentials handled securely by Firebase Authentication. We never see or store your password in plain text.

How we use it

We use your data only to run the service: to show you relevant listings, remind you about deadlines for roles you saved, let our team verify internships you suggest, and email you when a suggestion you made is reviewed. We do not sell your data, and we do not run advertising.

How listings are verified

Internships shown as Verified have been checked by an InternHub administrator against the source they link to. Applying happens on the organisation's own website or email; when you apply there, you deal directly with that organisation under its own privacy terms, not ours.

Where data is stored

Your account and content are stored on Google Cloud Firestore and Firebase Authentication. A small amount of data sits in your browser's local storage purely to remember interface choices such as a collapsed sidebar. This is not used to track you across websites.

Who can see your information

Your saved internships, notifications and profile are visible only to you. When you suggest an internship, the details you submit are seen by InternHub administrators so they can verify and, where appropriate, publish the listing. Published listings show the role and company, never your personal details.

Your rights

You can view and edit your profile any time under Account → Profile. You can download a copy of everything we hold about you under Account → Security → Export my data. You can permanently delete your account and its associated data from the same place. Deleting your account removes your InternHub profile, saved roles and notifications.

Children and students under 18

InternHub is intended for students and recent graduates. If you are under 18, please use the service with a parent or guardian's awareness.

Changes to this policy

If we make a meaningful change, we will update the date above and, where it affects you, tell you in the app.

Contact

Questions about privacy? Email us at hello@internhub.cm.
